title: Sherpa voice WASM bundle smoke test
description: Verifies the v2.0.1-built combined wasm bundle loads in the browser and contains the Cohere/Qwen3 symbol references. Does not download model weights, so it runs in seconds and works on any network. Real ASR roundtrip with Cohere/Qwen3 requires the model files to be hosted at the configured WEB_FEATURES['asr'] CDN.

prepare-ready-0.intent: The sherpa-voice app is running with the agentic bridge installed.
